units.text: з) involving, by 2030, at least 40 percent of medium-sized and large enterprises in the economy’s basic non-resource sectors and 100 percent of state and municipal social-sector organizations in projects aimed at increasing labor productivity;
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 6

units.text: и) creating, by 2030, an effective system for training, professional retraining and advanced training of personnel for priority sectors of the economy based on projected demand for such personnel;
units.label: Subpoint «и» Point 6

units.text: к) creating, by 2030, conditions for at least 30 percent of students to acquire several qualifications simultaneously within vocational and professional education;
units.label: Subpoint «к» Point 6

units.text: л) creating, by 2030, institutional conditions for the continuous professional development of working citizens, including acquiring new occupations and upgrading qualifications;
units.label: Subpoint «л» Point 6

units.text: м) reducing, by 2036, the disparity in fiscal capacity between the 10 most well-provided and the 10 least well-provided constituent entities of the Russian Federation to no more than twofold (taking into account financial support from the federal budget in the form of earmarked interbudgetary transfers);
units.label: Subpoint «м» Point 6

units.text: н) increasing the tourism industry’s share of gross domestic product to 5 percent by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «н» Point 6

units.text: о) ensuring that exports of non-resource, non-energy goods increase by at least two thirds by 2030 compared with the 2023 figure;
units.label: Subpoint «о» Point 6

units.text: п) increasing agricultural and agro-industrial output by at least 25 percent by 2030 compared with the 2021 level;
units.label: Subpoint «п» Point 6

units.text: р) increasing exports of agricultural and agro-industrial products to at least one and a half times the 2021 level by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «р» Point 6

units.text: с) establishing a network of stable partnerships with foreign states and creating the infrastructure necessary for foreign economic activity, technological and industrial cooperation, and entry into new markets;
units.label: Subpoint «с» Point 6

units.text: т) increasing exports of tourism services to three times the 2023 level by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «т» Point 6

units.text: у) increasing traffic volumes along international transport corridors to at least one and a half times the 2021 level by 2030 by enhancing the global competitiveness of the routes;
units.label: Subpoint «у» Point 6

units.text: ф) increasing the share of creative (artistic) industries in the economy;
units.label: Subpoint «ф» Point 6

units.text: х) approving and implementing climate change adaptation programs at the federal, regional and corporate levels;
units.label: Subpoint «х» Point 6

units.text: ц) establishing a national system for monitoring climate-active substances.
units.label: Subpoint «ц» Point 6

units.text: 7. Establish the following targets and tasks whose fulfillment characterizes the achievement of the national goal ‘Technological leadership’:
units.label: Point 7

units.text: а) ensuring technological independence and creating new markets in areas such as the bioeconomy, protecting citizens’ health, food security, unmanned aircraft systems, means of production and automation, transport mobility (including autonomous vehicles), the data economy and digital transformation, artificial intelligence, new materials and chemistry, advanced space technologies and services, and new energy technologies (including nuclear technologies);
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 7

units.text: б) increasing both gross value added in real terms and the production index in manufacturing by at least 40 percent by 2030 compared with the 2022 level;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 7

units.text: в) ensuring that the Russian Federation ranks among the world’s 10 leading countries by the volume of research and development by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 7

units.text: г) increasing domestic expenditure on research and development to at least 2 percent of gross domestic product by 2030, including by at least doubling private business investment for these purposes;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 7

units.text: д) increasing, by 2030, the share of domestically produced high-technology goods and services created on the basis of proprietary development lines in total consumption of such goods and services in the Russian Federation to one and a half times the 2023 level;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 7

units.text: е) increasing the revenue of small technology companies to at least seven times the 2023 level by 2030.
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 7

units.text: 8. Establish the following targets and tasks whose fulfillment characterizes the achievement of the national goal ‘Digital transformation of state and municipal administration, the economy and the social sphere’:
units.label: Point 8

units.text: а) achieving, by 2030, ‘digital maturity’ in state and municipal administration and key sectors of the economy and the social sphere, including healthcare and education, involving automation of most transactions within unified sectoral digital platforms and a data-driven management model, taking into account the accelerated introduction of big-data processing, machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 8

units.text: б) developing a data market, actively bringing data into economic circulation, and ensuring their storage, exchange and protection;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 8

units.text: в) increasing the share of households with access to high-quality, high-speed broadband connectivity to the Internet information and telecommunications network, including through satellite and mobile communication networks (infrastructure) and taking account of growth in backbone infrastructure bandwidth, to 97 percent by 2030 and to 99 percent by 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 8

units.text: г) ensuring, in 2025–2030, that investment in domestic information technology solutions grows at twice the rate of gross domestic product;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 8

units.text: д) ensuring that, by 2030, at least 80 percent of Russian organizations in key sectors of the economy switch to Russian system and application software in systems supporting their main production and management processes;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 8

units.text: е) increasing, by 2030, the share of Russian software used in state bodies, state corporations, state companies and business companies in whose charter capital the Russian Federation’s aggregate participation exceeds 50 percent, and in their affiliated legal entities, to 95 percent;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 8

units.text: ж) increasing, by 2030, the share of widely used, socially significant state and municipal services provided electronically to 99 percent, including introducing a decision-support system for the electronic provision of at least 100 widely used, socially significant state services proactively or upon an applicant’s direct request, through the introduction of a unified digital platform into the activities of state authorities;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 8

units.text: з) establishing a system for selecting, developing and rotating personnel for state authorities and local self-government bodies based on equal opportunities and the priority of professional knowledge and qualifications, including mechanisms for regular assessment and feedback within a unified digital platform;
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 8

units.text: и) ensuring, by 2030, an increase of at least 50 percent in citizens’ satisfaction with the quality of the work of state and municipal servants and employees of social-sector organizations;
units.label: Subpoint «и» Point 8

units.text: к) establishing a system for effectively countering crimes committed using information and telecommunications technologies and reducing the damage caused by such crimes;
units.label: Subpoint «к» Point 8

units.text: л) ensuring network sovereignty and information security in the Internet information and telecommunications network.
units.label: Subpoint «л» Point 8

units.text: 9. The Government of the Russian Federation shall:
units.label: Point 9

units.text: а) by 1 September 2024, in order to achieve the national goals and targets and fulfill the tasks provided for by this Decree, develop (adjust), with the participation of the State Council of the Russian Federation, and submit for consideration by the Presidential Council of the Russian Federation for Strategic Development and National Projects a group of national projects to ensure technological leadership, as well as the following national projects:
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9

units.text: ‘A Long and Active Life’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘A Long and Active Life’;”

units.text: ‘Family’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘Family’;”

units.text: ‘Youth and Children’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘Youth and Children’;”

units.text: ‘Personnel’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘Personnel’;”

units.text: ‘Infrastructure for Life’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘Infrastructure for Life’;”

units.text: ‘An Efficient Transport System’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘An Efficient Transport System’;”

units.text: ‘Environmental Well-being’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘Environmental Well-being’;”

units.text: ‘An Efficient and Competitive Economy’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘An Efficient and Competitive Economy’;”

units.text: ‘Tourism and Hospitality’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘Tourism and Hospitality’;”

units.text: ‘International Cooperation and Export’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘International Cooperation and Export’;”

units.text: ‘The Data Economy and Digital Transformation of the State’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 · “‘The Data Economy and Digital Transformation of the State’;”

units.text: б) by 1 September 2024, bring its acts into conformity with this Decree and submit proposals for bringing acts of the President of the Russian Federation into conformity with this Decree;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 9

units.text: в) by 31 December 2024:
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 9

units.text: develop and submit for consideration by the Presidential Council of the Russian Federation for Strategic Development and National Projects a unified plan for achieving the national development goals of the Russian Federation for the period up to 2030 and the outlook up to 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 9 · “develop and submit for consideration by the Presidential…”

units.text: develop and approve a spatial development strategy for the Russian Federation for the period up to 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 9 · “develop and approve a spatial development strategy for the…”

units.text: г) by 1 July 2025, develop, using the unified digital cartographic base of the Russian Federation, and approve a comprehensive plan for developing, for the period up to 2036, the transport, energy, telecommunications, social and other infrastructure necessary to achieve the national goals;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 9

units.text: д) annually, when preparing the draft federal budget for the next financial year and the planning period, give priority to budget appropriations for achieving the national goals;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 9

units.text: е) ensure that additional federal budget revenues arising during budget execution are allocated as a matter of priority to achieving the national goals.
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 9

units.text: 10. The Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation, jointly with the State Council of the Russian Federation, shall:
units.label: Point 10

units.text: а) develop and submit, by 1 October 2024, proposals for bringing Presidential Decree of the Russian Federation No. 68 of 4 February 2021 ‘On Evaluating the Effectiveness of the Activities of the Highest Officials of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation and the Activities of Executive Bodies of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation’ into conformity with this Decree;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 10

units.text: б) determine sociological indicators for achievement of the national goals and targets and fulfillment of the tasks provided for by this Decree, and ensure continuous monitoring of those sociological indicators.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 10

units.text: 11. Repeal Presidential Decree of the Russian Federation No. 474 of 21 July 2020 ‘On the National Development Goals of the Russian Federation for the Period up to 2030’ (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2020, No. 30, Article 4884).
units.label: Point 11

units.text: 12. This Decree enters into force on the day it is signed.
units.label: Point 12
